mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 600K units, indicating increased consumer spending, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 600K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by > 100K in a month, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to improved labor market conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with increasing INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% indicates slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by > 0.5% in a quarter and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above its 3-month moving average, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to tightening monetary conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9% always signals a high-risk environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE > 9% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the annual growth rate of real disposable personal income (RSAFS) is above 4% and housing starts (HOUST) are increasing, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to strong consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
